lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Staggered longitudinal rows of high-luminance circular pixel clusters distributed across the mid-to-posterior lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity that cross the longitudinal spot rows, forming a discernible grid-like pattern of anchor nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent horizontal linear features on the upper-lateral flank, characterized by a sharp vertical gradient from light superior edges to shadowed inferior edges.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a remora (Echeneidae) attached to the ventral-lateral surface posterior to the pectoral fin.
